name: GetManyCases
label: Get Many Cases
description: Retrieves multiple Case records using a SOQL query.

fields.name: Credential
fields.label: Credential to Connect With
fields.description: The Salesforce connection credential to use for authentication.

fields.name: Resource
fields.label: Resource
fields.description: The Salesforce object to operate on. Must be 'Case'.

fields.name: Operation
fields.label: Operation
fields.description: The operation to perform. Must be 'Get many cases'.

fields.name: SoqlQuery
fields.label: SOQL Query
fields.description: SOQL query to retrieve multiple Cases (e.g., SELECT Id, Subject FROM Case WHERE Status = 'New').

fields.name: Response
fields.label: Response
fields.description: The raw JSON response containing the list of Cases.
